title: Loud, not confusing
description: Boldness is a volume knob, not a blindfold. Every screamer earns its place by making the message clearer, never by decorating it.

title: Ship the weird version
description: The safe option gets you a site nobody remembers and nobody argues with. If a concept doesn't make someone on the call slightly nervous, it's beige.

title: Fast is a feature
description: Every page ships light and loads now. Speed is the one aesthetic choice every visitor notices, on every device, every single time.

title: One human, end to end
description: Strategy, design, and code from the same brain. No handoffs, no telephone game, no 'the dev team interpreted it differently'.
